name: John Meyers Sr.
description: Clarkson EE grad. Math teacher, fire alarm sales, then sole owner-operator of Taxi Zero. Practical and direct. Pushed JD toward the Part 107 certification and sat the exam alongside him. Deacon at CFC for decades. Still in Potsdam.
bio: BS and MS from Clarkson. Career arc: communications engineering → technical writing → internet marketing → entrepreneurship. Runs Taxi Zero (since 2013), Adirondack Quality Apartments, Airbnb short-term rentals, and three educational YouTube channels in parallel. Deacon at CFC since 1991. Co-took the FAA Part 107 exam with JD in April 2018 — both passed. Lost approximately $50,000 in stock options during the 2008 financial crisis, which changed the family's financial trajectory without the kids knowing at the time.
